reviewItem.question: Does "Line removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go: log.Info(\"Extra Resources are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-functions-extra-resources flag…" mean a change to cli-flag:crossplane|name=--enable-composition-functions-extra-resources|component=core (removed)?

proposed.statement: Crossplane v2.0.0 removes the --enable-composition-functions-extra-resources flag of the core command: the code line in cmd/crossplane/core/core.go stating that "Extra Resources are GA and cannot be disabled" and that the flag "will be removed in a future release" no longer exists in v2.0.0.
